mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, order_no, refund_no, refund_amount, product_refund_amount, freight_refund_amount, refund_quantity, clawback_bonus, reason, operator_id, operator_name, refund_time, create_time FROM dms_finance_refund WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY refund_time DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_finance_refund (order_id, order_no, refund_no, refund_amount, product_refund_amount, freight_refund_amount, refund_quantity, clawback_bonus, reason, operator_id, operator_name, refund_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{refundNo}, #{refundAmount}, #{productRefundAmount}, #{freightRefundAmount}, #{refundQuantity}, #{clawbackBonus}, #{reason}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{refundTime})
